hand from the pages in a browser; the tests check the parsers against them.

## showdocs_60169.html: G.R. No. 193038, Nobleza v. Nuega
- "755 Phil. 656"; THIRD DIVISION; [ G.R. No. 193038, March 11, 2015 ]; D E C I S I O N; VILLARAMA, JR., J.
- First paragraph begins "At bar is a petition for review on certiorari of the Decision[1] dated May 14, 2010".
- Ends "SO ORDERED." then "Velasco, Jr. (Chairperson), Peralta, Reyes, and Jardeleza, JJ., concur."
  After that the clerk's NOTICE OF JUDGMENT (dated June 2, 2015), which is not part of the decision.
- 37 footnotes; [1] "Rollo, pp. 30-52. Penned by Associate Justice Celia C. Librea-Leagogo ..."; [37] "Id. at 48-49."
- Disposition: the petition is denied ("WHEREFORE, the petition is DENIED ... AFFIRMED").
- No separate opinion.

## showdocs_59651.html: G.R. No. 203655, SM Land v. BCDA (resolution)
- SPECIAL THIRD DIVISION; [ G.R. No. 203655, March 18, 2015 ]; R E S O L U T I O N; VELASCO JR., J.
- The motion for reconsideration is denied. Ends "Leonen, J., I dissent. See separate opinion." before a spaced
  "N O T I C E OF J U D G M E N T" block.
- 34 footnotes in the resolution.
- One separate opinion: DISSENTING OPINION by LEONEN, J., beginning "I dissent." and ending
  "ACCORDINGLY, I vote to GRANT the Motion for Reconsideration.", with its own 40 footnotes.
